details:
So iv been on the platform of IMVU for 15 years. I no longer use it due to the company ignoring alot of issues in the community, surrounding underage users and drama. But the platform is just not as enjoyable anymore and the people just seem boring and miserable. There is a few things VRCHAT can learn from this site. VRCHAT STAFF if you ever see this Id be very much willing to take an interview on my experiences with IMVU. So I think this would very much help the VRCHAT community have a better less stressful and awkward time chatting with people.
- Separate / try to separate adults from minors on this site /chatrooms.
- Have room rules to separate said users from certain rooms.
- Report people lieing about their ages (EX - someone who is actually 13 but saying they're 22 in the community)
- Try to set age restrictions and have the ability to set your age on your profile card.
- Ability to verify your adult age by proving you are over 18 (yes I know people will have a problem with this but literally all you have to do is cover things on a ID that you dont want them to see, they only need to see your name,age,and ID number and issuing state, you can cover everything else. Blizzard also has this system to verify account ownership as well fyi. Mind you, your license number is mostly public records, just like your license plate number is public. Anyways thats another argument. However this would be a choice, but that would be up to VRCHAT to decide. IMVU you paid 5 dollars, and you uploaded these things and you got the verification badge.)
- Ability to text/voice message people on website / inbox messages on here. (I personally hate not being able to message people)
- Being able to turn on or off notifications that your friends just logged on.
- Ability to mute players in the social tab of the current room if you cant click on their avatars because EX moving around to much or something you cant click on the player. (if this is a thing sorry, still kinda new)
- Ability to upload or search avatars in a hub / tab instead of having to go to worlds to see them.
- Ability to have creators to directly pay for premium avatars through the software, or have a program that allows them to sell premium avatars or services through your software. (doesn't have to be in game, could be web based so we could add and take away avatars when we are not on the VRCHAT platform)
- Ability to look at our avatars on the website (EX spin the t-posing avatar on a separate screen to look at it)
- Maybe have a program to allow creators to subscribe to be verified avatar developers for VRCHAT specifically ?
- Maybe have a program for creators to submit avatars to a "overwatch" system which would consist of volunteer community members who will try on an avatar and make sure it is not broken or NSFW content. (this would be community driven, and to help it work, give the people who participate in a certain amount of times a year, a discount of VRC plus , Community Badge, free merch or something along those lines)
title: Some Ideas from a 15 year IMVU user (age verification/separation, creator ideas, inboxes)
